tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List artifacts currently bound to this run. Memory, persona, context, media, and session files appear here only if policy already made their ArtifactRefs visible.

label.description: Optional exact artifact id label filter.

tools.name: read_artifact
tools.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 range from one artifact currently bound to this run. The result reports the exact continuation offset; non-text carriers fail closed so the supporting interface can materialize them.

id.description: Visible artifact id or content hash.

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes to return. Defaults to 65536.

offset_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte offset returned by a previous read. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: search_artifacts
tools.description: Search text surfaces of artifacts currently bound to this run. Results never include artifacts outside the run binding.

label.description: Optional exact artifact id label filter.

tools.name: publish_widget
tools.description: Create or update an Octopus client widget or document. The complete input schema is the client renderer contract and is validated before emission; use its exact glyphs, targets and render nodes. Use the exact System presentation interface from the bound Home delivery artifact. The result proves artifact admission, not rendering or extension installation. Same document id with a larger revision replaces an earlier valid or rejected revision. Read the bound artifact-home-widget-authoring contract for delivery and native/sandbox documents.

interface.description: Exact granted System presentation interface, never a guessed Home/client World address.

source.description: Native image literals must be embedded AVIF, GIF, JPEG, PNG, or WebP base64 data URLs (at most 524288 characters), not HTTP(S), file, or blob URLs. A value binding must resolve to the same embedded format.

tools.name: open_client_surface
tools.description: Request navigation to an existing visible Octopus client surface using its exact surface_id. Use the bound Home delivery System presentation interface. Only the receiving Home client can apply this presentation action. Admission is not proof that a client has rendered it; unavailable or hidden surfaces refuse visibly. Does not execute external URLs, files, commands, or task mutations.

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open an existing text file or Markdown document in the running client's right Files pane. Create or update the file first through granted file tools, then provide its absolute path. Use client_action.interface from the bound Home delivery context and a unique request_id. The client checks its admitted Files roots and reads the file before selecting its tab. Missing, unreadable, binary or oversized files fail explicitly. This call waits for the client result; opening confirms the readable target and tab request, not rendered pixels. It does not execute the file, launch another application or restart the client.

tools.name: inspect_client
tools.description: Inspect the running Octopus client before writing an Extension or its data source. Read-only. The client returns client.action.result with request_id and client: the Extensions root, packages_root and package layout, contract schema files written by this client build, host vocabulary (categories, targets, slots, native nodes, glyphs, projection sources with params, host sources, client actions, limits), visible surfaces, every Extension with admission (pending/reviewed/dismissed/builtin), installation, setup and runtime issues, and refused packages with exact issues. extension_id narrows the Extension rows to one package. source previews what one client surface projection returns, bounded, so bindings can be written against real rows. Use client_action.interface from the bound Home delivery context and a unique request_id.  This call waits for the running client and returns the actual saved state or an explicit failure. Continue dependent work from this result in the same turn. Do not end the turn to wait, poll, repeat an admitted request, or use Computer Use for these controls.

tools.name: list_widgets
tools.description: List ready-made and published widgets in the current Home, including exact ids, revision digests, installed and visible state. Use client_action.interface from the bound Home delivery context. Choose a unique request_id.  This call waits for the running client and returns the actual saved state or an explicit failure. Continue dependent work from this result in the same turn. Do not end the turn to wait, poll, repeat an admitted request, or use Computer Use for these controls.

tools.name: relaunch_client
tools.description: Restart the running Octopus client after you rebuilt it, so the operator sees your client change. The system and every run keep running while the client restarts, including this one; the operator signs in again. Use client_action.interface from the bound Home delivery context and a unique request_id.  This call waits for the running client and returns the actual saved state or an explicit failure. Continue dependent work from this result in the same turn. Do not end the turn to wait, poll, repeat an admitted request, or use Computer Use for these controls.

tools.name: set_widget
tools.description: Show, hide or remove one or more existing Home widgets in one call. List every change in changes, each with the exact widget_id and source_digest from list_widgets and its target state; enable or disable several widgets together rather than one call per widget. Visible enables a configured built-in through the normal extension lifecycle; custom widgets need no source edits. Use client_action.interface from the bound Home delivery context. Choose a unique request_id.  This call waits for the running client and returns the actual saved state or an explicit failure. Continue dependent work from this result in the same turn. Do not end the turn to wait, poll, repeat an admitted request, or use Computer Use for these controls.

description: Octopus client MCP. Call with method tools/call and params {name, arguments}. For existing widgets, the complete arguments are {interface, action:{schema:"octopus.client_action",schema_version:1,action:"list_widgets",request_id:"new unique id"}}. Copy interface from client_action.interface in the bound Home delivery artifact. To change the returned inventory, use name:"set_widget" and action:"set_widget" with changes:[{widget_id,source_digest,state:"visible"|"hidden"|"removed"}]; copy exact widget ids and digests from list_widgets. Both calls return actual saved client state in this tool call. No document-authoring guide or full catalogue read is needed for these controls. Use tools/list for other operations: inspect_client reports client/Extension contracts, publish_widget creates a document, open_client_surface opens an existing view, open_file opens a text document in the right Files pane, and artifact operations inspect only bound artifacts. Effects cross artifact.send under the current grant. No ambient host configuration or global client access.
